scope: YOLO26n Axelera SDK 1.7.0 PTQ screening on the frozen ten-image COCO subset

source_profiles.end_to_end_equivalence_scope: The two end-to-end sources had max raw output delta 0.0 on the frozen ten images only; this is not whole-domain equivalence.

terminal_findings: Histogram plus single_asymmetric completed 200 calibration images on opset 17 but failed the pinned-zero MatMul export constraint.
Three min-max compiler-flag ablations produced byte-identical candidate predictions to the baseline.
Raw-output min-max moved NMS/top-k out of the INT8 graph and was the only candidate with material improvement.
No candidate passed all gates and no new AIPU quality or latency claim is supported.
confounders: The frozen ten-image set is a screening set, not a held-out or full-COCO accuracy result.
The raw-output graph uses a different external decoder and source reference from the end-to-end graph, so absolute mAP values are not a controlled cross-graph comparison.
Only one deterministic calibration ordering was run for the raw-output candidate.
The screen decoder uses argmax while the YAML evaluation override enables multi-label decoding; AIPU postprocessing parity is unproven.
The apparent mAP gain may be caused by coarse score ties/reordering and added detections rather than faithful confidence recovery.
The CPU simulator is directionally useful but historically much more optimistic than real AIPU execution.
next_steps: First establish raw-FP32 external-decoder equivalence against the native/end-to-end reference.
Repeat raw-output PTQ with a distinct calibration seed and evaluate on a preregistered disjoint held-out set.
Run layerwise sensitivity analysis on the confidence-head Conv/Sigmoid path; keep sensitive outputs in higher precision if the SDK permits it.
Test a newer Axelera SDK/compiler that resolves the pinned-zero MatMul exporter constraint.
If PTQ remains outside gates, use targeted QAT or an explicit Q/DQ export, subject to verified Axelera import support.
Compile and execute on AIPU only after a candidate improves both frozen and held-out gates and the translation service releases the device.

review.harness: Independent reviewer ACCEPTED before execution after two blockers were fixed.
review.scientific_ptq_plateau: Independent reviewer discarded all end-to-end compiler-flag candidates and recommended the raw-output graph intervention.
